cim: Artificial intelligence is inflating medical bills
cim_eredeti: Artificial intelligence is inflating medical bills
szoveg_eredeti:
Just when the healthcare system seemed as complicated as it could get, artificial intelligence has stepped in to introduce a new set of hurdles.

Medical debt in particular appears to be one of those hurdles set to become even harder to overcome.

Dr. Jarrel De Matas is an assistant professor at the University of Texas Medical Branch.
